name: Ganguro Bitch Imouto o Tanezuke Choukyou
original_name: ガングロビッチ妹を種付け調教
source:
Suddenly she went from innocent and kawaii type to whore slut ganguro.
But deep down she was still my adorable little sister.
I saw through her facade and force f*cked her to make her see the light.
But she was stubborn. Tsundere imouto that she is.
"You love a giving head don't you!"
"Th... that's right! G-glur-fkck!"
We took it further and further, until finally...
translation:
突然间，她从天真可爱的类型变成了妓女荡妇黑鬼。
但内心深处她仍然是我可爱的妹妹。
我看穿了她的外表，强迫她上床，让她看到光明。
但她很固执。她就是傲娇。
“你喜欢奉献精神，不是吗！”
“这……就是啊！咕咕咕！”
我们越走越远，直到最后……
